# Target class `Dataset` — slot inventory

Derived from `src/data_sheets_schema/schema/data_sheets_schema_all.yaml`. Structure only: this states what shape a record takes, never what any dataset contains.

98 slots. `[req]` must be populated; `[many]` takes a list. A slot with an enum range accepts only the listed values.

## `acquisition_methods` — *InstanceAcquisition* [many]
Methods used to acquire or obtain dataset instances. List of InstanceAcquisition objects from the Collection module describing how data was sourced, whether directly observed or derived.

## `addressing_gaps` — *AddressingGap* [many]
Research or practical gaps this dataset addresses. List of AddressingGap objects from the Motivation module, each describing a gap in existing datasets or knowledge that this dataset fills.

## `annotation_analyses` — *AnnotationAnalysis* [many]
One or more analyses of annotation quality and inter-annotator agreement.

## `anomalies` — *DataAnomaly* [many]
Known data quality issues, errors, or irregularities in the dataset. List of DataAnomaly objects from the Composition module, each documenting a specific anomaly and its potential impact.

## `at_risk_populations` — *AtRiskPopulations*
Information about protections for at-risk populations (e.g., minors, pregnant women, prisoners) including special safeguards and assent procedures.

## `citation` — *string*
Recommended citation for this dataset in DataCite or BibTeX format. Provides a standard way to cite the dataset in publications.

## `cleaning_strategies` — *CleaningStrategy* [many]
Data cleaning and quality control procedures applied to the dataset. List of CleaningStrategy objects from the Preprocessing module describing outlier removal, deduplication, and error correction steps.

## `collection_consents` — *CollectionConsent* [many]
Consent obtained from individuals for data collection and use. List of CollectionConsent objects from the Ethics module describing how consent was requested, provided, and documented.

## `collection_mechanisms` — *CollectionMechanism* [many]
Mechanisms, instruments, or tools used for data collection. List of CollectionMechanism objects from the Collection module describing sensors, surveys, APIs, or other collection instruments.

## `collection_notifications` — *CollectionNotification* [many]
Notifications provided to individuals about data collection. List of CollectionNotification objects from the Ethics module describing how and when individuals were informed about the data collection.

## `collection_timeframes` — *CollectionTimeframe* [many]
Time periods during which data was collected. List of CollectionTimeframe objects from the Collection module describing collection start and end dates, and any gaps in the collection period.

## `compression` — *CompressionEnum*
Compression format used, if any (e.g., gzip, bzip2, zip).
Permitted: `gzip`, `bzip2`, `zip`, `tar`, `xz`, `lzma`, `compress`

## `confidential_elements` — *Confidentiality* [many]
Confidential or restricted information within the dataset that requires access controls. List of Confidentiality objects describing what is confidential and why it cannot be released.

## `conforms_to` — *string*
A standard or specification the **dataset's own content** follows — an imaging, waveform, file-layout or common-data-model standard such as DICOM, WFDB, BIDS, OMOP CDM, Open mHealth or ESDS. Not the schema this datasheet is written in: that is `conforms_to_schema`.

## `conforms_to_class` — *string*
The class within `conforms_to_schema` that this record instantiates — `Dataset` for a full datasheet, `CoreDataset` for a core one. Like `conforms_to_schema`, a statement about the record rather than the data.

## `conforms_to_schema` — *string*
The metadata schema **this record itself** is written in — normally `https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema`. A statement about the datasheet, not about the data it describes; a standard the *data* follows belongs in `conforms_to`.

## `conforms_to_standard` — *DataStandardEnum* [many]
Which registered data standard `conforms_to` names, where one applies — a term rather than prose, so the corpus can be queried for "what standards does this follow?" (#403). `conforms_to` records what the sources say, in their words. This records which standard that is. Populate both for the same s…
Permitted: `DICOM`, `BIDS`, `OMOP_CDM`, `WFDB`, `OPEN_MHEALTH`, `ESDS`, `CDS`, `RO_CRATE`, `FHIR`, `OTHER`

## `consent_revocations` — *ConsentRevocation* [many]
Mechanisms for individuals to revoke previously given consent. List of ConsentRevocation objects from the Ethics module describing how revocation works and what happens to data after revocation.

## `content_warnings` — *ContentWarning* [many]
Content warnings for potentially harmful, offensive, or disturbing material in the dataset. List of ContentWarning objects alerting users to sensitive content categories.

## `created_by` — *string*
The person or organization primarily responsible for creating the resource.

## `created_on` — *datetime*
The date and time when the resource was created. Requires a UTC offset (`…T00:00:00Z`); RFC 3339 `date-time` rejects a naive timestamp.

## `creators` — *Creator* [many]
Individuals or organizations who created the dataset. List of Creator objects describing authorship, roles, and affiliations of dataset creators.

## `data_collectors` — *DataCollector* [many]
Individuals or organizations responsible for collecting the data. List of DataCollector objects from the Collection module describing who performed data collection and their roles.

## `data_governance` — *DataGovernance*
Who decides who may use this dataset, and how. DataGovernance object from the Data Governance module describing the access committee, its membership and contacts, the review process, and who remains accountable for the data over time. Distinct from `license_and_use_terms` (the terms) and `regulator…

## `data_protection_impacts` — *DataProtectionImpact* [many]
Data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) conducted for the dataset. List of DataProtectionImpact objects from the Ethics module documenting privacy risk assessments and mitigation measures.

## `description` — *string*
A human-readable description for a thing.

## `direct_collection` — *DirectCollection* [many]
Whether data was collected directly from individuals or via third parties. List of DirectCollection objects from the Collection module describing direct vs. indirect collection methods and sources.

## `discouraged_uses` — *DiscouragedUse* [many]
Uses that are not recommended for this dataset due to limitations, risks, or ethical concerns. List of DiscouragedUse objects from the Uses module explaining why certain applications should be avoided.

## `distribution_dates` — *DistributionDate* [many]
Dates when the dataset was or will be distributed or released. List of DistributionDate objects from the Distribution module describing initial release dates, version release dates, and planned future releases.

## `distribution_formats` — *DistributionFormat* [many]
Formats in which the dataset is distributed or made available. List of DistributionFormat objects from the Distribution module describing file formats, compression, and access methods.

## `doi` — *string*
Digital Object Identifier (DOI) in format 10.xxxx/xxxxx — a registrant prefix, a slash, a suffix — providing persistent identification. The bare DOI only — not the doi: CURIE and not the doi.org resolver URL. The pattern is anchored (#646): unanchored, JSON Schema's search semantics accepted all th…

## `download_url` — *uri*
URL from which the data can be downloaded. This is not the same as the landing page, which is a page that describes the dataset. Rather, this URL points directly to the data itself.

## `errata` — *Erratum* [many]
Known errors or corrections to the dataset since publication. List of Erratum objects from the Maintenance module describing discovered errors, affected records, and correction procedures.

## `ethical_reviews` — *EthicalReview* [many]
Ethical reviews and institutional oversight for the dataset. List of EthicalReview objects from the Ethics module describing IRB approvals, ethics committee reviews, and compliance certifications.

## `existing_uses` — *ExistingUse* [many]
Known existing uses of the dataset at the time of publication. List of ExistingUse objects from the Uses module describing research, commercial, or other applications of the dataset.

## `extension_mechanism` — *ExtensionMechanism*
Mechanisms for extending or contributing to the dataset. ExtensionMechanism object from the Maintenance module describing how others can propose additions, corrections, or expansions.

## `external_resources` — *ExternalResource* [many]
External resources referenced at the dataset level (e.g., related publications, repositories, documentation). For file-level external resources, use FileCollection.external_resources.

## `file_collections` — *FileCollection* [many]
Collection of file groups within this dataset. Each entry represents a logical grouping of files with shared characteristics (e.g., all training data, all image files, all raw data files). Maps to nested RO-Crate Dataset entities via schema:hasPart in RO-Crate converters.

## `funders` — *FundingMechanism* [many]
Funding mechanisms that supported dataset creation. List of FundingMechanism objects describing grants, contracts, or other funding sources including grantors and grant identifiers.

## `future_use_impacts` — *FutureUseImpact* [many]
Anticipated impacts of future uses, including risks and benefits. List of FutureUseImpact objects from the Uses module describing foreseeable consequences of using this dataset in new applications.

## `human_subject_research` — *HumanSubjectResearch*
Information about whether dataset involves human subjects research, including IRB approval, ethics review, and regulatory compliance.

## `id` — *uriorcurie* [req]
A unique identifier for a thing.

## `imputation_protocols` — *ImputationProtocol* [many]
Data imputation protocols applied to handle missing values. List of ImputationProtocol objects from the Preprocessing module describing the imputation technique, affected variables, and rationale.

## `informed_consent` — *InformedConsent* [many]
One or more records detailing informed consent procedures, including consent type, documentation, and withdrawal mechanisms.

## `instances` — *Instance* [many]
Individual data instances or records in the dataset. List of Instance objects from the Composition module describing what each data point represents, its type, and associated label information.

## `intended_uses` — *IntendedUse* [many]
List of explicit intended and recommended uses for this dataset. Complements future_use_impacts by focusing on positive applications.

## `ip_restrictions` — *IPRestrictions*
Intellectual property restrictions on dataset use or redistribution. IPRestrictions object from the Data Governance module describing copyright, trademark, or other IP considerations.

## `is_deidentified` — *Deidentification*
De-identification status and procedures applied to the dataset. Deidentification object describing whether the dataset contains personal data, what de-identification methods were applied, and any residual re-identification risks.

## `is_tabular` — *boolean*
Whether the dataset is in tabular format (rows and columns). True if the data is structured as a table (e.g., CSV, TSV, relational database); false for unstructured formats such as images or free text.

## `issued` — *datetime*
Date of formal issuance or publication of the resource. A `datetime` renders as RFC 3339 `date-time`, which **requires a UTC offset** — write `2024-11-15T00:00:00Z`, not `2024-11-15T00:00:00`. A date alone is also rejected.

## `keywords` — *string* [many]
Keywords or tags describing the resource for discovery and classification.

## `known_biases` — *DatasetBias* [many]
List of known biases present in the dataset that may affect fairness, representativeness, or model performance. Uses BiasTypeEnum for standardized bias categorization mapped to the AI Ontology (AIO).

## `known_limitations` — *DatasetLimitation* [many]
List of known limitations of the dataset that may affect its use or interpretation. Distinct from biases (systematic errors) and anomalies (data quality issues).

## `labeling_strategies` — *LabelingStrategy* [many]
Labeling or annotation methodologies applied to the data. List of LabelingStrategy objects from the Preprocessing module describing annotation procedures, annotator qualifications, and quality controls.

## `language` — *string*
Language in which the information is expressed.

## `last_updated_on` — *datetime*
The date and time when the resource was most recently modified or updated. Requires a UTC offset (`…T00:00:00Z`); RFC 3339 `date-time` rejects a naive timestamp.

## `license` — *string*
The legal license under which the resource is made available (e.g., "MIT", "CC-BY-4.0").

## `license_and_use_terms` — *LicenseAndUseTerms*
License and usage terms governing dataset access and use. LicenseAndUseTerms object from the Data Governance module describing the applicable license, permitted uses, and any restrictions.

## `machine_annotation_tools` — *MachineAnnotationTools* [many]
List of automated annotation tools used in dataset creation.

## `maintainers` — *Maintainer* [many]
Individuals or organizations responsible for maintaining the dataset. List of Maintainer objects from the Maintenance module describing maintenance contacts, roles, and support channels.

## `missing_data_documentation` — *MissingDataDocumentation* [many]
One or more records documenting missing data patterns and handling strategies.

## `modified_by` — *string*
A person or organization that contributed to modifying or updating the resource.

## `name` — *string*
A human-readable name for a thing.

## `notes` — *string*
Residual content only, after every fitting slot is used — structured slots first, then description; notes solely for what description cannot hold (#385). Never invent keys (#380).

## `other_tasks` — *OtherTask* [many]
Additional tasks the dataset may support beyond its original intent. List of OtherTask objects from the Uses module describing potential applications not originally planned by the dataset creators.

## `page` — *string*
A landing page or web page providing access to or information about the resource.

## `parent_datasets` — *Dataset* [many]
One or more parent datasets that this dataset is part of or derived from. Enables hierarchical dataset composition (hasPart/isPartOf relationships).

## `participant_compensation` — *HumanSubjectCompensation* [many]
One or more records describing compensation or incentives provided to human research participants.

## `participant_privacy` — *ParticipantPrivacy* [many]
One or more records describing privacy protections and anonymization procedures for human research participants.

## `preprocessing_strategies` — *PreprocessingStrategy* [many]
Preprocessing steps applied to the raw data. List of PreprocessingStrategy objects from the Preprocessing module describing normalization, transformation, and other preparation steps.

## `prohibited_uses` — *ProhibitedUse* [many]
List of explicitly prohibited or forbidden uses for this dataset. Stronger than discouraged_uses - these are not permitted.

## `publisher` — *uriorcurie*
The organization or entity responsible for making the resource available.

## `purposes` — *Purpose* [many]
Purposes for which the dataset was created. List of Purpose objects from the Motivation module, each describing a specific creation goal or intended application.

## `raw_data_sources` — *RawDataSource* [many]
List of raw data sources before preprocessing. Each RawDataSource object describes where the original data came from and how it can be accessed.

## `raw_sources` — *RawData* [many]
Raw, unprocessed source data before any preprocessing was applied. List of RawData objects from the Preprocessing module describing original data sources and their formats.

## `regulatory_restrictions` — *ExportControlRegulatoryRestrictions*
Regulatory and export control restrictions applicable to the dataset. ExportControlRegulatoryRestrictions object from the Data Governance module describing compliance requirements such as ITAR, EAR, or GDPR.

## `related_datasets` — *DatasetRelationship* [many]
List of related datasets with typed relationships (e.g., supplements, derives from, is version of). Use DatasetRelationship class to specify relationship types.

## `relationships` — *Relationships* [many]
Explicit relationships between individual instances in the dataset. List of Relationships objects from the Composition module describing how instances relate (e.g., graph edges, ratings, social network links).

## `resources` — *Dataset* [many]
Sub-resources or component datasets that are part of this dataset. Note: For file collections, use the file_collections attribute instead.

## `retention_limit` — *RetentionLimits*
Data retention policies and limits for the dataset. RetentionLimits object from the Maintenance module describing how long the dataset will be available and any deletion schedules.

## `sampling_strategies` — *SamplingStrategy* [many]
Strategies used to select data instances from a larger population. List of SamplingStrategy objects from the Collection module describing sampling methodology, inclusion criteria, and limitations.

## `sensitive_elements` — *SensitiveElement* [many]
Sensitive data elements requiring special handling or access controls. List of SensitiveElement objects identifying sensitive attributes such as personal identifiers, protected health information, or legally sensitive content.

## `source_caveats` — *string*
Commentary on the evidence behind this object's values — source conflicts, what a value was transcribed from, questions the source material leaves unanswered (#385). A trust annotation about the sibling slots, not dataset content: content belongs in the structured slots, description or notes.

## `splits` — *Splits* [many]
Recommended data splits for this dataset. List of Splits objects from the Composition module describing train/validation/test partitions and the rationale for each split strategy.

## `status` — *string*
The status of the resource (e.g., draft, published, deprecated).

## `subpopulations` — *Subpopulation* [many]
Subpopulations represented within the dataset. List of Subpopulation objects from the Composition module describing demographic or other groups, their representation, and any imbalances.

## `subsets` — *DataSubset* [many]
Subsets or splits of this dataset. List of DataSubset objects from the Composition module, each representing a logical partition such as training, validation, or test splits, or demographic subgroups.

## `tasks` — *Task* [many]
Tasks the dataset is intended to support. List of Task objects from the Motivation module describing specific machine learning, research, or analytical tasks.

## `third_party_sharing` — *ThirdPartySharing* [many]
Third-party distribution policies for the dataset. List of ThirdPartySharing objects from the Distribution module describing whether and how the dataset is shared with entities outside the creating organization.

## `title` — *string*
The official title of the element.

## `total_file_count` — *integer*
Total number of files across all file collections in this dataset. Can be aggregated from file_collections[].file_count.

## `total_size_bytes` — *integer*
Total size of all files in bytes across all file collections. Can be aggregated from file_collections[].total_bytes.

## `updates` — *UpdatePlan*
Plans for future updates or versioning of the dataset. UpdatePlan object from the Maintenance module describing update frequency, versioning policy, and planned enhancements.

## `use_repository` — *UseRepository* [many]
Repositories or registries tracking how the dataset has been used. List of UseRepository objects from the Uses module pointing to papers with code, citation indices, or other use-tracking resources.

## `variables` — *VariableMetadata* [many]
List of metadata records describing individual variables, fields, or columns in the dataset.

## `version` — *string*
The version identifier of the resource (e.g., "1.0", "2.3.1").

## `version_access` — *VersionAccess*
Information about access to different versions of the dataset. VersionAccess object from the Maintenance module describing where older versions can be found and how version history is maintained.

## `was_derived_from` — *string*
A resource from which this resource was derived, in whole or in part.
